on_default.description:
OnDefault is true when this cell's limit was coalesced from the org-wide
default user budget (a defaulted spender with no explicit budget row)
rather than read from an explicit row. Server-provided so a client can
distinguish an exception (explicit budget) from a cell on the default.

ordinal.description: Ordinal is the group charge-precedence position (0 for user cells).

remaining_usd.description: RemainingUSD is LimitUSD minus UsedUSD clamped at zero.

next_cursor.description: NextCursor pages forward; absent on the last page.

code.description:
Code is the specific machine-readable reason within Type. Optional: a
message-only error omits it.

message.description: Message is the human-readable description, safe to show to the caller.

type.description:
Type is the broad class of the error. Optional: a message-only error
omits it.
